anomalies.observed: On sheet /EPD_Driver/ the capacitor C1 sits directly on the display power rail (Display_Power_Switch to GND, next to C2) and is drawn with the value 0.1 uF / 16 V.
anomalies.expected: This capacitor is one of the Pervasive-Displays reference-circuit decoupling capacitors that the specification lists as 1 uF / 25 V; it should be 1 uF / 25 V, not 0.1 uF / 16 V.

evidence.quote: "C1" / "0.1uF/16V" on the Display_Power_Switch rail beside "C2" / "1uF/6.3V" (sheet EPD_Driver, tile 1, left of L1 10uH)
| C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default |

anomalies.impact: The EPD power rail that feeds the panel VDD/VDDIO pins and the boost inductor L1 is now bypassed with a capacitor ten times smaller (and rated 16 V instead of 25 V). The rail is less well decoupled against the boost converter's switching edges, which can degrade the e-paper drive waveforms, and the lower voltage rating reduces margin; the board would still power up, but with different (worse) display-rail noise behaviour than intended.

parsed.summary: The design is largely consistent with the specification, but the EPD driver sheet's input decoupling capacitor C1 is populated as 0.1 uF/16 V instead of the specified 1 uF/25 V (the only stated passive value that disagrees with the drawing), which is a sourcing/value deviation on the display power rail.
